No dithering, no blur, no gradients, no bloom, no cast ground shadow. One complete two-storey reused historic red-brown brick shop building on transparent background. A wide, squat rectangular footprint; straight south-facing facade with horizontal cornice and roof line, no visible angled side wall, no rotated/isometric building. Warm old brick masonry, a dark blue-grey shallow roof behind a dentilled cornice, three tall upper sash windows with sandstone lintels, an occupied ground floor with two large glass display windows and a single centered dark entrance directly facing down. A repaired muted teal fabric awning above the ground floor, older cream signboard ABOVE the awning deliberately left blank. Whole roof/chimney/cornice/base fully within canvas, at least eight transparent pixels all around. Ground-floor door 18 to 22 pixels wide. No readable text, letters, numbers, people, objects outside the building, sidewalks, grass, trees, surrounding scene, background rectangle, floating platform, stairs or cut-off eaves.
